note: Schemas document tool input. Original Zod contracts and API service rules remain authoritative, including refinements and record scopes.

operations.name: reports.payments
operations.description: Payment counts and amounts by payment date; only verified amounts are collected funds. Optional dateFrom/dateTo, batch and status.

operations.name: reports.collections
operations.description: Membership balances, verified credit and batch totals. Balances are current lifetime amounts, not period revenue.

operations.name: reports.reconciliation
operations.description: Review flags and verification audit evidence, not external bank-statement matching.

operations.name: reports.tasks
operations.description: Task outcomes filtered by creation dates; never automatic wage actions.

operations.name: reports.support
operations.description: Support counts for cases created in the date range.

operations.name: reports.installment_earnings
operations.description: Scheduled installments, not verified collections or profit. For this month use Manila current year, frequency MONTHLY, period=current month. groupBy batches or members; paginated rows and overall totals.

operations.name: reports.batches
operations.description: Search batch IDs and labels for reporting filters.

operations.name: records.batches
operations.description: Search batches by q, status and page. Returns IDs and current versions.

operations.name: records.batch
operations.description: Read exact batch and current version before editing.

operations.name: records.assignment_options
operations.description: Look up eligible agent IDs and staff assignments. Do not invent IDs.

operations.name: records.create_batch
operations.description: Create a batch. Ask for required model, status, start/end dates and agent; server generates code. Optional installment terms must be complete.

checks.message: Use a positive amount with at most two decimal places.

operations.name: records.update_batch
operations.description: Edit a batch using its exact current version and full record; preserve fields not requested. Archive via supported status, never delete financial history.

checks.message: Use a positive amount with at most two decimal places.

operations.name: records.clients
operations.description: Search scoped memberships and clients by q, batch, status and page.

operations.name: records.client
operations.description: Read a client membership, balance and version. Personal contact data is private.

operations.name: records.schedule
operations.description: Read the chosen membership's issued installment schedule.

operations.name: records.create_client
operations.description: Create a client membership in an existing batch. Required personal details must come from the user.

operations.name: records.update_client
operations.description: Edit membership details with current version/full record; balances cannot be directly edited.

operations.name: agents.list
operations.description: Search private agent directory and IDs.

operations.name: agents.detail
operations.description: Read agent details and version before edits.

operations.name: agents.create
operations.description: Add an agent profile, not a login or access grant.

operations.name: agents.update
operations.description: Edit or deactivate an agent using full record/current version.

operations.name: catalog.list
operations.description: Search all catalog listings including unpublished items.

operations.name: catalog.detail
operations.description: Read a catalog item's current terms and version.

operations.name: catalog.create
operations.description: Create a catalog item with explicitly provided terms; no invented prices.

checks.message: Use letters, numbers and hyphens for the listing code.
Enter a price with at most two decimal places.
Enter a total with at most two decimal places.

operations.name: catalog.update
operations.description: Edit prices, terms or publication with full record/current version. Unpublish rather than erase historical agreements.

checks.message: Use letters, numbers and hyphens for the listing code.
Enter a price with at most two decimal places.
Enter a total with at most two decimal places.

operations.name: catalog.remove_image
operations.description: Delete a catalog photo with current item version; does not delete the listing.

operations.name: tasks.list
operations.description: Search task records in the user's staff scope.

operations.name: tasks.staff
operations.description: Find eligible staff IDs for task assignment.

operations.name: tasks.create
operations.description: Create an assigned task with user-provided title, instructions, deadline and priority.

operations.name: support.queue
operations.description: Read paginated customer support queue.

operations.name: support.detail
operations.description: Read the selected support case, messages and current version.

operations.name: support.update
operations.description: Edit case status, assignment or resolution with its current version.

operations.name: support.create
operations.description: Record a customer support concern and its actual source.

operations.name: jobs.list
operations.description: Search job openings. Does not expose confidential applicants.

operations.name: jobs.detail
operations.description: Read a job opening and current version.

operations.name: jobs.create
operations.description: Create a job opening from supplied details.

operations.name: jobs.update
operations.description: Edit or close a job opening with current version/full record.

operations.name: retention.candidates
operations.description: List deletion candidates under existing retention policy and holds.

operations.name: retention.preview
operations.description: Read-only preview of the exact records affected by erasure. Must precede a deletion request.

operations.name: retention.policies
operations.description: Read active retention periods, basis, approval and backup/external-copy obligations.

operations.name: retention.holds
operations.description: Read legal holds that can block a deletion.

operations.name: retention.requests
operations.description: Read existing deletion requests and their approved state.

operations.name: retention.request
operations.description: Create a retention deletion request from its exact preview. Does not approve or erase records.
